name: osg-e2e
description: Real-binary Windows journeys driven through tauri-driver and the actual WebView.

scripts.$comment: run-isolated.mjs discovers or accepts journeys, then launches one fresh WDIO process per spec. The config therefore creates a distinct database/WebView root before each application spawn; adding a journey cannot silently omit it from the default suite.
scripts.test: node --test run-isolated.test.mjs support/workflowEvidence.test.mjs && node run-isolated.mjs journeys/startup.journey.js journeys/defaultFont.journey.js
scripts.test:all: node --test run-isolated.test.mjs && node run-isolated.mjs && node scenarios/editPersistRelaunch.mjs && node scenarios/unicodeCues.mjs && node scenarios/translationPersistence.mjs && node scenarios/nativeToolsInstall.mjs
scripts.test:workflows: node run-isolated.mjs journeys/urlToPreview.journey.js && node scenarios/editPersistRelaunch.mjs && node scenarios/unicodeCues.mjs && node scenarios/translationPersistence.mjs && node scenarios/nativeToolsInstall.mjs
scripts.test:screenshot-workflows: node run-isolated.mjs journeys/freshInstallVisual.journey.js journeys/urlToPreview.journey.js journeys/urlLocalAsrPreview.journey.js journeys/localAsrGeneration.journey.js journeys/narrationGeneration.journey.js journeys/nativeExportDecoded.journey.js journeys/geminiCredentialBoundary.journey.js journeys/geminiOutputPreview.journey.js journeys/canvasPlaybackPerformance.journey.js && node scenarios/editPersistRelaunch.mjs && node scenarios/unicodeCues.mjs && node scenarios/translationPersistence.mjs && node scenarios/nativeToolsInstall.mjs
